services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: An I-Power School of Gymnastics Birthday Party combines a safe, clean, bright facility, and highly trained instructors, with the fun and flexibility of a structured birthday celebration! Ages 1-5 years old! Party time starts with 60 minutes of open playtime led by I-Power Staff and 30 minutes of celebration time. Includes a bounce house, birthday t-shirt, tablecloths & paper products (choose 1-2 solid colors) juice, and an I-Power water bottle with goodies for all the party kids. Extra party kids: $10 each (maximum of 18 participants)Available add ons: themed paper products $20, cupcakes

blurb: I-Power Ninja Academy Mission Statement Providing a fun, challenging, yet rewarding outlet to develop Fitness.
